The '''Byrne City Municipal Building''' was a governmental facility in [[Byrne City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. During the evacuation of the planet in the face of the impending [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took control of the building for use in the relief coordination. [[Jared Fronz]] maintained an office in the building.<ref name="SWE">{{WEGCite|story=The Beginning of the End|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
